title: RankSpot – Get Customers from Google & AI Search
excerpt: RankSpot is your fully automated AI agent that researches, writes, and publishes SEO articles to your blog daily - getting you cited in AI answers and ranked on Google.
content_html:
Trusted by 50+ founders

Get customers from
Google & Claude

Your fully automated AI agent that researches, writes, and publishes SEO
articles to your blog daily - getting you cited in AI answers and ranked on Google.

Start for free

First 3 articles for free

Major problems

We've talked to hundreds of
founders. SEO is always the problem.

Sounds familiar?

You know you should be publishing content. You wrote 2 blog posts this year.

ChatGPT recommends your competitors. Not you.

You got a $3,000/month quote from an SEO agency. You closed the tab.

You tried writing articles yourself. It took 5 hours. You never did it again.

You Google your own industry. Your competitors are everywhere. You're nowhere.

Your competitors are on page 1 of Google. You're not.

Solution

Your personal SEO/GEO
AI agent that works 24/7

From keyword research to publishing – RankSpot handles your entire SEO pipeline automatically, every single day.

How it works

3 simple steps to get started

Set it up once. Get SEO articles published to your blog every single day.

Product features

Everything your SEO needs, in one place

Keyword research, competitor tracking, daily articles, Reddit opportunities - all under one roof.

Daily SEO Articles

Research-backed articles published to your blog every day - optimized for Google and AI answers.

Target the right keywords

See exactly which keywords your customers search for - ranked by opportunity so you always publish what matters most.

Monitor your competitors

Add your competitors' URLs and RankSpot tracks their keywords automatically - so you can target what's already working for them.

Reddit & forum opportunities

Find real conversations where your customers are asking for solutions - and get your business in front of them.

Integrations

Connected to your website in minutes

Connect your website once - RankSpot publishes every article automatically, every day. Works with WordPress, Webflow, Wix, Shopify, Framer, Ghost, and more.

Start for free

Global

Supports 100+ languages

Reach customers in their native language - RankSpot writes and publishes articles in 100+ languages automatically.

Writing examples

AI-generated content that feels human

Testimonials

Real results from real founders

See what founders say after putting their SEO on autopilot.

Our Pricing

No hidden fees. No contracts. Cancel anytime.
